svg.text: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W GPIO header (top view, pin 1 = 3V3) · net labels connect by name
anode (long leg) → resistor → GPIO · cathode (flat side) → GND
1 kΩ at 3.3 V gives about 1–1.5 mA per LED: enough
for bright LEDs, gentle on the GPIOs. Dim LEDs:
free. The amp gets 5 V from pin 4, its logic runs
at 3.3 V levels. Enable it with dtoverlay=max98357a.
